segments.ja449:1.1: Alaṅkato maṭṭhakuṇḍalī [maṭṭakuṇḍalī (sī. pī.)], māladhārī [mālabhārī (sī. pī.)] haricandanussado;
segments.ja449:1.3: Bāhā paggayha kandasi, vanamajjhe kiṃ dukkhito tuvaṃ.
segments.ja449:2.3: Tassa cakkayugaṃ na vindāmi, tena dukkhena jahāmi jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja449:3.3: [ācikkha me bhaddamāṇava (vi. va.1209)] Pāvada rathaṃ karissāmi [kārayāmi (sī. pī.)] te [ācikkha me bhaddamāṇava (vi. va.1209)], cakkayugaṃ paṭipādayāmi taṃ.
segments.ja449:4.1: So [atha (syā.)] māṇavo tassa pāvadi, candimasūriyā [candimasūriyā (syā.)] ubhayettha bhātaro [dissare (vi. va.1210)];
segments.ja449:4.3: Sovaṇṇamayo ratho mama, tena cakkayugena sobhati.
segments.ja449:5.1: Bālo kho tvaṃsi māṇava, yo tvaṃ patthayase apatthiyaṃ;
segments.ja449:5.3: Maññāmi tuvaṃ marissasi, na hi tvaṃ lacchasi candasūriye.
segments.ja449:6.3: Peto pana neva dissati, ko nu kho [ko nidha (vi. va.1212)] kandataṃ bālyataro.
segments.ja449:7.1: Saccaṃ kho vadesi māṇava, ahameva kandataṃ bālyataro;
segments.ja449:7.3: Candaṃ viya dārako rudaṃ, petaṃ kālakatābhipatthaye.
segments.ja449:8.1: Ādittaṃ vata maṃ santaṃ, ghatasittaṃva pāvakaṃ;
segments.ja449:8.3: Vārinā viya osiñcaṃ, sabbaṃ nibbāpaye daraṃ.
segments.ja449:9.1: Abbahī [abbuhi (syā.), abbhuḷhaṃ (ka.)] vata me sallaṃ, yamāsi hadayassitaṃ [sokaṃ hadayanissitaṃ (vi. va.1215)];
segments.ja449:10.3: Na socāmi na rodāmi, tava sutvāna māṇavāti.
